full_judgment: 2. Short facts necessary for disposal of the Rule are that the Opposite Parties as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 181 of 1997 in the Court of learned Assistant . Judge, 1st additional Court, Dhaka praying for, cancellation of a deed dated 18.4.1983 being No. 6339, registered at Dhaka sub-registry office. That suit was dismissed on contest by the judgment and decree dated 30.9.1999 against which the Opposite Parties No. 1-3 has preferred Title Appeal No. 699 of 1999: During pendency of the appeal the Opposite Party Nos. 4-16 submitted an application in the appeal for adding them parties claiming then to be purchaser in 311/2 decimal of land out of the suit land. Abdul Si)bahan & Ors Vs.
